description: This file defines the AIService class which provides AI-powered text processing functionalities such as transcript summarization and key point extraction, with stub implementations and support for OpenAI API integration.

classes.name: AIService
classes.description: A service class for handling AI-powered transcription, summarization, and key point extraction tasks, with stub implementations and optional OpenAI API integration.
